caption: The drawing displays an architectural blueprint of a chair from multiple perspectives. On an off-white, slightly stained and discolored background, black ink lines outline four views of the same object: a full frontal view of the chair is positioned on the left, featuring a curved backrest with an openwork splat and cabriole legs; next is a side view of the chair, showing the curvature of the back and the contour of the seat and legs; above the side view is a top-down view depicting the chair’s seat in a trapezoidal shape with visible seat rails; to the right of the top view is an elevation of the chair viewed from the front of the seat, highlighting the stretcher and front legs. A scale is included below the side view, labeled “1 foot,” and the name “H. Granet” appears in the lower right corner. The lines are carefully rendered and formal, focusing solely on the structural aspects of the chair without any added ornamentation, color fill, or shading.
title: Side Chair
